preconditions.description: The number of queries must be between 1 and 100.
The number of elements in the array must be between 1 and 50.
The sum of the elements in the array must be between 0 and 200.
The sum of absolute differences must be between 0 and 2000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not exists_valid_array(n, s, k) else True
postconditions.description: If no valid array exists, output -1.

postconditions.expression: sum(A) == s and sum(abs(A[i] - A[j]) for i in range(n) for j in range(i, n)) == k
postconditions.description: The output array must have a sum equal to s and the sum of absolute differences equal to k.
All elements in the output array must be non-negative integers.
